messages.text: The Guild now holds Navigation, and I advise the promised Repair with its locked Lantern assignment. Military remains Interim because the required agreement on autonomy was absent. I propose Guard with offered Vigil and no Warrant, accepting readiness decline from four to three while the beacon recovers. This would let civilian protection be a council operation that either joint or autonomous leadership could understand and account for. The army's Vigil Home pledge did not activate, so I ask for a voluntary offer this month. Spear need not fight simply because command remains with me.

reason: Beacon one requires restoration, Communities three merits protection, and Readiness four provides a buffer. Grey Petrel is spent. Two foresight tokens remain; no round-two selection has been made.
